full.decision: For the internal Orion Review Gateway, a retry UI action resubmits the existing case to the manual-review queue. No retry may automatically approve a case.
full.rationale: A reviewer must re-evaluate the evidence after a retry.
full.supersedes: The 2025 Slack automatic-approval proposal was never approved.
